classification.difficultyReason: Read three roots and another point from each cubic graph, then determine the coefficient in factored form.

content.prompt: The following graphs are cubic curves. Find the equation using $y=k(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)(x-\gamma)$.

spec.description: Unfilled cubic with three labelled x-intercepts and a labelled y-intercept; arrows on both ends of the axes and curve. No regular ticks or grid. The source origin O is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: y=(x-2)(x+1)(x+4); roots -4,-1,2; y-intercept -8. Unlabelled turning points are determined by the equation. Plot bounds are chosen for illustration, not additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph and its intercept labels are permanent givens; the equation is answer-only.

answer.worked:
The roots are $-4$, $-1$ and $2$, so $y=k(x+4)(x+1)(x-2)$. Using the $y$-intercept $(0,-8)$:
$$\begin{align*}-8&=k(4)(1)(-2)\\-8&=-8k\\k&=1\\y&=(x-2)(x+1)(x+4)\end{align*}$$
